records.text: In a comedic monologue, Tim Dillon speculated that Erika Kirk was a Mossad handler who probably had Charlie Kirk killed, then said he was not claiming any of it happened.
records.speaker: Tim Dillon

appearances.snippet: Because even though she was his Mossad handler and probably had him killed, no marriage is perfect. None. ... And I'm not saying any of that happened. I'm saying that's more reasonable than what kind of we're being told. That's all.

verification.notes: The episode preserves both Dillon's satirical handler accusation and his explicit disclaimer that he was not saying it happened. Verification is limited to that attributed comedic performance.
